title: Maha Context Pack evaluation request
description: Evaluates whether caller-declared exact evidence spans survive deterministic Context Pack compilation. Source, evidence and compiled context text are processed transiently and not retained in the ledger. Retention is exact span matching only: it is not factual accuracy, answer quality or verification. Accepted by POST /api/context-pack-evaluations (128,000 bytes) and by the Deep Context Evaluation x402 offer at POST /api/v1/compress/evaluate (1,050,000 bytes). An x402 payment settles before the body is validated, so validate against this schema before paying.

id.description: Stable source ID, unique within the request.

text.description: No per-document character cap: the request is bounded by its byte limit.

evidenceId.description: Your label for this span, unique within the request.

sourceId.description: Must reference a supplied document id.

text.description: An exact span from the declared source document.

provenance.description: Inline citation style in the rendered pack.
